title: 2017 Bowman Draft Refractor #BDC-5 Franklin Perez Houston Astros Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft sports trading card features Franklin Perez, a player for the Houston Astros in Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is a Chrome Refractor variation, with a card number of BDC-5. It is an insert card from the 2017 Bowman Draft set, manufactured by Topps.

The card is perfect for collectors of baseball trading cards and fans of the Houston Astros. It is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress. Don't miss out on the chance to own this amazing card!
